title: Native Integer Token Separators
objective: Normalize integer token separators without altering strings or exactness

handoff.summary: Normalize separators only in exact integer literal tokens so native literal recognizers see exact canonical digits. Validate separator placement before normalization because the CST grammar admits some trailing separators. Original source tokens and spans, explicit constructor strings, floating literals, and nonexact Python numbers remain unchanged. Focused regressions cover frontend JavaScript emission and native IR including exact values beyond 2^53, uint64 boundaries, annotated locals, module constants, defaults, and unary negatives. CPython agrees on seven valid values and five invalid tokens.
